figures.label: S1
figures.caption: Figure S1: Lattice parameter of Co-substituted LLZTO calculated with the empirical formula of Strocka et al. [3] for Co3+ on the Li, Zr, and La sites and for Co2+ on the Li site, as a function of the Co content x. Empirical formulas exist in the literature that allow the lattice parameter of garnets to be calculated from the ionic radii [1] of the ions on the different structural sites.[2] We tested them and found that the formula of Strocka et al. [3] gives the best agreement with the crystallographic data (.cif files) of Kataoka et al. [4] for LLZTO. Figure S1 shows that for Co2+ as well as Co3+ on the Li site essentially no change of the lattice parameter is expected. Even for Co3+ on the Zr site the change is small for x ≤ 0.1.
